description: Default preset for use with Open Collective repos
schedule: every weekday after 2:00 am before 6:00 am

packageRules.description: Our own packages are trusted, update immediately without any delay
Do not pin trusted GitHub-owned actions
Do not pin CI service images: their digests change on every upstream rebuild and only add PR noise
Production runs PostgreSQL 16: keep every repo's CI database on 16.x
Production runs Valkey 9.1 (Heroku Key-Value Store): keep every repo's CI cache on 9.1. Raise the cap when Heroku upgrades; the floating minor tag can be a release candidate (9.2 was 9.2.0-rc1)
